name: high-impact-earbud-ad
image_purpose: e-commerce product advertising and campaign key visual

prompt.project_info: Create a high-impact e-commerce infographic advertisement for a generic wireless-earbud product.
prompt.main_subject: Foreground: an extreme close-up of a hand holding an open glossy white wireless-earbud charging case toward the camera, containing two sleek white earbuds with black speaker accents and a tiny glowing green LED status light. Mid-ground: one adult woman with original fictional identity, freckles, wavy pastel-pink hair, a vibrant lime-green knit beanie, a psychedelic black-and-white striped long-sleeve shirt, and one white earbud in her ear.
prompt.composition_elements: Use macro foreground product emphasis with slight depth blur on the hand and case, a smiling adult model in the mid-ground, blurred white earbuds floating artistically in the background, and a clean light-grey gradient studio backdrop. Arrange abstract white sans-serif typography: large generic wireless-audio headline at top center, product descriptor at top right, premium sound and noise-cancellation claim at mid-left, 30 hours of battery life at mid-right, and 1 year warranty at bottom-right. Keep all text generic and readable only as supplied claims; no brand or logo.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft professional studio lighting highlights glossy product plastic, with diagonal rainbow prism lens flares and soft light leaks adding vibrant playful energy while preserving clear product readability and a premium commercial finish.
prompt.technical_specs: 8K-style commercial product photography, sharp focus on charging case and earbuds, shallow depth of field on model/background, macro-lens product perspective, clean infographic layout, realistic skin and product texture, no watermark.

prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish styling, minors, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, real brand logos, trademarked product names, misleading claims, distorted hands, extra fingers, malformed earbuds, duplicate case, plastic skin, waxy skin, over-smooth skin, airbrushed skin, HDR look, unreadable text, watermark

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No image reference is required for this text-derived template. Preserve the generic wireless-earbud product, macro case foreground, adult pastel-haired model, lime beanie, striped shirt, light-grey studio, rainbow prism flares, product hierarchy, commercial infographic layout, and supplied battery/warranty claims. Replace brand names, logos, and trademarked product identifiers with generic readable descriptors; do not invent additional claims.

changes: Removed Apple/AirPods trademark and branded product naming, replacing them with generic wireless-earbud descriptors while preserving the product-advertising composition, model styling, typography hierarchy, and stated claims.
